Main reweighting routine for TurboRVB quantum Monte Carlo calculations.

This subroutine performs reweighting calculations for quantum Monte Carlo simulations. It handles both electronic and ionic degrees of freedom, including dynamics.

1646 indscra = indscra + 2

1655 indscra = indscra + 2
1656 end if

1660 &, factorsr_sav(i), enert(1:ipc, i), i=1, in1)

1664

1686 end if
1687 else

1689 &, reduce, ncg, econf(i, 1), in1, 0.d0, psip(n3), 1)
1690 end if
1691 end if
1692 if (yes_hessc) then
1693 do jj = ncg + 1, nps

1695 end do
1696 do jj = ncg + 1, nps
1697 ind = type_complex(ipip(n3 + jj - 1))
1698 if (ind .eq. 0) then
1699 psip(n3 + 2*jj - 1) = 0.d0
1700 elseif (ind .eq. 1) then
1701 psip(n3 + 2*jj - 1) = econf(i, ipip(n3 + jj - 1) + 1)
1702 elseif (ind .eq. 2) then
1703 psip(n3 + 2*jj - 1) = -econf(i, ipip(n3 + jj - 1) - 1)
1704 end if
1705 end do
1706 psip(n3 + 2*nps) = 1.d0
1707 psip(n3 + 2*nps + 1) = 0.d0
1708 else
1709 do jj = ncg + 1, nps
1710 psip(n3 + jj - 1) = econf(i, ipip(n3 + jj - 1))
1711 end do
1712 psip(nps + n3) = 1.d0
1713 end if
1714 if (ncg .gt. 0) then
1715 if (allocated(index) .and. k_par .lt. nps .or. yes_hessc) then
1716 do jj = 1, k_par
1717 v1(jj) = econfh(i, index(jj))
1718 end do
1719 if (yes_hessc) then
1720 call dgemv('N', ncg, k_par, 1.d0, mat, ncg, v1, 1, 0.d0, psip(n4), 2)
1721 do jj = 1, k_par
1722 ind = type_complex(index(jj))

1724 v1(jj) = 0.d0

1726 v1(jj) = econfh(i, index(jj) + 1)
1727 elseif (ind .eq. 2) then
1728 v1(jj) = -econfh(i, index(jj) - 1)
1729 end if
1730 end do
1731 call dgemv('N', ncg, k_par, 1.d0, mat, ncg, v1, 1, 0.d0, psip(n4 + 1), 2)
1732 else
1733 call dgemv('N', ncg, k_par, 1.d0, mat, ncg, v1, 1, 0.d0, psip(n4), 1)
1734 end if
1735 else
1736 call dgemv('N', ncg, np, 1.d0 &
1737 &, reduce, ncg, econfh(i, 1), in1, 0.d0, psip(n4), 1)
1738 end if
1739 end if
1740 if (yes_hessc) then
1741 do jj = ncg + 1, nps
1742 psip(n4 + 2*jj - 2) = econfh(i, ipip(n3 + jj - 1))
1743 end do
1744 do jj = ncg + 1, nps
1745 ind = type_complex(ipip(n3 + jj - 1))
1746 if (ind .eq. 0) then
1747 psip(n4 + 2*jj - 1) = 0.d0
1748 elseif (ind .eq. 1) then
1749 psip(n4 + 2*jj - 1) = econfh(i, ipip(n3 + jj - 1) + 1)
1750 elseif (ind .eq. 2) then
1751 psip(n4 + 2*jj - 1) = -econfh(i, ipip(n3 + jj - 1) - 1)
1752 end if
1753 end do
1754 psip(2*nps + n4) = enert(1, i)
1755 psip(2*nps + n4 + 1) = -enert(2, i) ! We should mantain the conventions adopted.
1756 else
1757 do jj = ncg + 1, nps
1758 psip(n4 + jj - 1) = econfh(i, ipip(n3 + jj - 1))
1759 end do
1760 psip(nps + n4) = enert(1, i)
1761 end if
1762
1763 ! now update matrices
1764 costw = cost*factorsr_sav(i)
1765 costwe = costw*enert(1, i)

1777 ! call dsyrk('U','T',npps,2,costwe,psip(n3),2,1.d0,sov(1,1,5),npm)
1778 call dgemm('T', 'N', npps, npps, 2, costwe, psip(n3), 2, psip(n3), 2&
1779 &, 1.d0, sov(1, 1, 5), npm)

1781 costwe = costw*enert(2, i)
1782 do j = 0, 2*npps - 1, 2
1783 psip(n4 + j) = -psip(n3 + j + 1)
1784 psip(n4 + j + 1) = psip(n3 + j)

1787 &, 1.d0, sov(1, 1, 5), npm)

1792 end if
1793 end do
1794 end do

1797 if (allocated(index)) then

1799 if (allocated(truecomplex)) deallocate (truecomplex)
1800 if (allocated(type_complex)) deallocate (type_complex)

1802 end if

1811 call reduce_base_real(nptot, sov, commrep_mpi, -1)
1812 end if
1813#endif
1814

1816
1817 else

1819 if (allocated(truecomplex)) deallocate (truecomplex)
1820 if (allocated(type_complex)) deallocate (type_complex)

1826 if (itest .ne. -5) then
1827 ! matrix-5

1829 do i = 1, npps

1845 sov(j, i, 5) = sov(i, j, 5)

1847 end do
1848 end do
1849
1850 end if ! endif itest.ne.-5

1854 ! now replace the reduced parts of s(*,*,1) and s(*,*,2)
1855 ! Strictly speaking in the complex case I am not using the semiorthogonal basis
1856 ! but the original basis O_k |Psi> and O_0|Psi> , O_0=I ,the Real part is taken
1857 ! after in a way that the strong zero variance property is preserved.
1858 ! This implies that <O_k> = Re < O_k O_0> --> Re <O_k>.
1859
1860 do i = 1, nps
1861 do j = 1, nps
1862 sov(i, j, 1) = sov(i, j, 1) - sov(i, npps, 1)*sov(j, npps, 2) ! only scorrelat

1864 end do
1865 end do

1867 ! Evaluation of the matrix G
1868
1869 do i = 1, nps
1870 do j = 1, nps
1871 sov(i, j, 5) = sov(i, j, 5) &
1872 & - sov(npps, i, 2)*sov(npps, j, 5) - sov(npps, j, 2)*sov(i, npps, 5) &
1873 & + sov(npps, npps, 5)*(sov(npps, i, 2)*sov(npps, j, 2) - sov(i, j, 2))
1874 end do

1969 & sov(npps, i, 1) - sov(npps, npps, 1)*sov(npps, i, 2)

1984 end do

1998#endif
1999
2000 ipip(npps) = 1

2008 indj = indj + 1
2009 sov(indi, indj, 3) = sov(i, j, 5)
2010 sov(indi, indj, 4) = sov(i, j, 2)
2011 end if
2012 end do
2013 end if

2021 indj = 0

2027 end do
2028 end if

2040 end if

2047 !#endif

2051

2053
2054 if (yes_dgelscut) then
2055
2056 do i = 1, indi

2067 indj = indi

2073 if (indi .ne. i) call dcopy(indj, sov(1, i, 4), 1, sov(1, indi, 4), 1)

2078 end if
2079

2081

2084

2087
2088 ! Now compute right eigenvectors

2092

2094

2099
2100 end if ! endif info ne 0

2107

2109 &, sov(1, 1, 3), npm, 0.d0, sov(1, 1, 5), npm)
2110
2111 do i = indi + 1, indj

2123 indj = 0

2129 end do
2130 end if
2131 end do
2132

2134! if(rank.eq.0) write(6, *) ' Eigenvalues, Real , Imag , weight old '
2135 do i = 1, indi
2136 if (sov(indi, i, 5) .ne. 0.d0) then
2137 cnorm = 0.d0

2139 do k = 1, indi - 1

2141 end do
2142 end do
2143 if (cnorm .ne. 0.d0) then
2144 cnorm = 1.d0/dsqrt(cnorm)
2145 call dscal(indi, cnorm, sov(1, i, 5), 1)
2146 cost = sov(indi, i, 5)**2
2147 cost = cost/(cost + 1.d0)
2148 else
2149 cost = 1.d0
2150 end if
2151 else
2152 cost = 0.d0
2153 end if
2154! if(rank.eq.0) write(6, 124) i, psip(i), psip(n2 - 1 + i), cost
2155 end do
2156124 format(i12, 3f15.8)
2157
2158 ! Choose the closest real eigenvalue < 0= reference energy
2159 imin = 0
2160 eigmin = 0.d0
2161 do i = 1, indi
2162 ! the gain in energy / norm orth component is maximum
2163 cost = -psip(i)*abs(sov(indi, i, 5))
2164 if ((cost .gt. eigmin .or. imin .eq. 0) &
2165 &.and. psip(i) .lt. 0.d0) then
2166 ! if((cost.gt.eigmin.or.imin.eq.0).and.psip(n2-1+i).eq.0.d0
2167 imin = i
2168 eigmin = cost
2169 end if
2170 end do
2171
2172 ! stop
2173
2174 if (imin .eq. 0 .and. rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Warning all positive eigenvalues '
2175 ! Then no constraint on energy gain, choose the closest real
2176
2177 over2 = sov(indi, max(imin, 1), 5)**2
2178 over2 = over2/(1.d0 + over2)
2179
2180! if(rank.eq.0) write(6, *) ' Warning Chosen the closest '
2181 eigmin = 0.d0
2182 do i = 1, indi
2183 cost = sov(indi, i, 5)**2/(1.d0 + sov(indi, i, 5)**2)
2184 if (cost .gt. eigmin .or. imin .eq. 0) then
2185 imin = i
2186 eigmin = cost
2187 end if
2188 end do
2189 over2 = eigmin
2190
2191 eigmin = psip(imin)
2192
2193 if(rank.eq.0) write(6, *) 'Chosen Eigenvalue (new-previous)'//&
2194 &' #, Real/Ima3g, dimension H', imin, psip(imin) / 2.d0, psip(n2-1+imin)/2.d0,indi_save
2195
2196 do i = 1, indi - 1
2197 psip(i + n2 - 1) = sov(i, imin, 5)/sov(indi, imin, 5)
2198 end do
2199
2200! if((1.d0 - over2).gt.-epsi.and.epsi.lt.0.d0) then
2201! if(rank.eq.0) write(6, *) ' Warning decelerated move too much large !!! '
2202! cost = -epsi / (1.d0 - over2)
2203! do i = 1, indi - 1
2204! psip(i + n2 - 1) = cost * psip(i + n2 - 1)
2205! ! write(6,*) i,psip(i+n2-1)
2206! enddo
2207!
2208! endif
2209
2210 ! now simple steepest descent for the parameters without hessian
2211 indi = indi - 1
2212 indin = indi
2213
2214 if (idyn .gt. 0 .and. rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Ion forces '
2215 do i = npps, np
2216 ! if(ipip(i).eq.2) then
2217 indin = indin + 1
2218 ! a factor two is needed
2219 ! psip(indin)=-sov(i,npp,5)*2.d0
2220 psip(indin) = forza(i)
2221 if (idyn .gt. 0 .and. rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) i, forza(i), err(i)
2222 ! endif
2223 end do
2224 ndsr = indin - indi
2225 indin = indi + 1
2226
2227 ! write(6,*) ' ndsr FOUND =',ndsr
2228
2229 ! save cov for output before it is destroyed by ion_dyn
2230 if (write_cov) then
2231 cov_sav(1:ieskin*ieskin) = cov(1:ieskin*ieskin)
2232 end if
2233#ifdef PARALLEL
2234 call mpi_barrier(mpi_comm_world, ierr)
2235#endif
2236 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Before dynamic ', info, idyn
2237 if (ndsr .ne. 0) call ion_dynamics
2238 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' After dynamic ', info
2239
2240 if (write_cov .and. acc_dyn .and. rank .eq. 0) then
2241 write (18, 123) ((ris(4)*cov_sav(ii + (jj - 1)*ieskin), ii=jj, ieskin), jj=1, ieskin)
2242 end if
2243
2244 ! write(6,*) ' ipip, Solution found '
2245 ! write(6,*) ' Normal parameters '
2246
2247 indi = 0
2248 do i = 1, nps
2249 if (ipip(i) .eq. 1) then
2250 indi = indi + 1
2251 psip(i) = psip(n2 + indi - 1)
2252 else
2253 psip(i) = 0.d0
2254 end if
2255 ! write(6,*) i,ipip(i),psip(i)
2256 end do
2257
2258 indin = indi
2259 if (idyn .gt. 0 .and. rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Forces '
2260 do i = npps, np
2261 ! if(ipip(i).eq.2) then
2262 indi = indi + 1
2263 psip(i) = psip(n2 + indi - 1)
2264 ! endif
2265 if (idyn .gt. 0 .and. rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) i, psip(i)
2266 end do
2267
2268 ! evaluation norm correction
2269
2270 cost = 0.d0
2271 do i = 1, indin
2272 do j = 1, indin
2273 cost = cost + psip(n2 + i - 1)*psip(n2 + j - 1)*sov(j, i, 4)
2274 end do
2275 end do
2276
2277 cost = dsqrt(cost)
2278 costn = 1.d0
2279
2280 if (cost .gt. abs(epsi) .and. epsi .ne. 0) then
2281 costn = abs(epsi)/cost
2282
2283 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Warning decelerated ', costn
2284 call dscal(nps, costn, psip, 1)
2285 end if
2286
2287 if (epsi .lt. 0 .and. cost*1.5 .lt. -epsi) then
2288 epsi = -1.5*cost
2289 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) 'Warning changing epsi on the fly =', epsi
2290 end if
2291 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Norm correction = ', costn*cost
2292 norm_corr = costn*cost
2293
2294 if (np .gt. ncg) then
2295
2296 if ((abs(klr) .eq. 6 .or. abs(klr) .eq. 7 .or. abs(klr) .eq. 2) .and. ncoll .eq. 1 .and. rank .eq. 0)&
2297 & write (6, *) ' Dt found =', psip(1)*tjas
2298 scale_grad = psip(1)
2299
2300 if (ncoll .eq. 1 .and. psip(1) .lt. 0 .and. npbra .eq. 0) then
2301 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Move rejected negative Dt !!! '
2302 if (.not. change_tpar) psip(1) = 0.d0
2303 end if
2304
2305 if (ncg .gt. 0) then
2306 call dgemv('T', ncg, npr, 1.d0, reduce, ncg, psip, 1, 0.d0, psip(n2), 1)
2307 else
2308 call dscalzero(npr, 0.d0, psip(n2), 1)
2309 end if
2310 ! write(6,*) ' Updated old corr ',np
2311 do jj = ncg + 1, np
2312 indscali = ipip(n3 + jj - 1)
2313 ! write(6,*) ' before =',jj,indscali,psip(n2+indscali-1),psip(jj)
2314 psip(n2 + indscali - 1) = psip(n2 + indscali - 1) + psip(jj)
2315 end do
2316
2317 else
2318
2319 if ((abs(klr) .eq. 6 .or. abs(klr) .eq. 7 .or. abs(klr) .eq. 2) .and. ncoll .eq. 1 .and. rank .eq. 0)&
2320 & write (6, *) ' Dt found =', psip(1)*tjas
2321 scale_grad = psip(1)
2322
2323 if (ncoll .eq. 1 .and. psip(1) .lt. 0) then
2324 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Move rejected negative Dt !!! '
2325 if (.not. change_tpar) psip(1) = 0.d0
2326 end if
2327 call dgemv('T', np, npr, 1.d0, reduce, ncg, psip, 1, 0.d0, psip(n2), 1)
2328 end if
2329
2330 call dcopy(npr, psip(n2), 1, psip, 1)
2331
2332 np = npr
2333 npp = npr + 1
2334
2335 end if
2336
2337 elseif (itest .eq. -5) then
2338
2339 info = 0
2340
2341 numpar = 1
2342 if (signalnoise .and. idyn .eq. 0) np = 1 ! ionic forces are not treated independently
2343 ipip(1) = 1
2344 psip(1) = 1.d0
2345
2346 if (ieskin .ne. 0 .and. idyn .gt. 0) then
2347 indi = numpar
2348 indin = indi
2349 ! store the solution found in psip(n2)
2350 call dcopy(np, psip, 1, psip(n2), 1)
2351 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Ion forces '
2352 do i = npps, np
2353 ipip(i) = 2
2354 indin = indin + 1
2355 ! the io
2356 psip(indin) = forza(i)
2357 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) i, psip(indin), err(i)
2358 end do
2359 ndsr = indin - indi
2360 if (ndsr .ne. 0) call ion_dynamics
2361
2362 ! write(6,*) ' Solution found '
2363
2364 indi = 0
2365 do i = 1, nps
2366 if (ipip(i) .ne. 0) then
2367 indi = indi + 1
2368 psip(i) = psip(n2 + indi - 1)
2369 else
2370 psip(i) = 0.d0
2371 end if
2372 ! write(6,*) i,ipip(i),psip(i)
2373 end do
2374 ! write(6,*) ' after loop ',indi
2375
2376 indin = indi
2377 ! write(6,*) ' Normal parameters '
2378 do i = npps, np
2379 ! write(6,*) ' after ipip,psip',i,ipip(i),psip(n2+i-1)
2380 ! if(ipip(i).eq.2) then
2381 indi = indi + 1
2382 psip(i) = psip(n2 + indi - 1)
2383 ! endif
2384 ! write(6,*) i,psip(i)
2385 end do
2386 end if
2387
2388 ! if(ncg.gt.1) then
2389
2390 ! cost=0.d0
2391 ! do i=1,nps
2392 ! do j=1,nps
2393 ! cost=cost+psip(i)*psip(j)*sov(j,i,1)
2394 ! enddo
2395 ! enddo
2396 !
2397 !
2398 ! cost=dsqrt(cost)
2399
2400 cost = tjas*dsqrt(normsr)
2401 if (.not. signalnoise) then
2402 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Norm correction = ', cost
2403 norm_corr = cost
2404
2405 if (cost .gt. abs(epsi) .and. epsi .ne. 0) then
2406 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Warning decelerated by ', epsi/cost
2407 cost = abs(epsi)/cost
2408 psip(1) = cost
2409 end if
2410 if (epsi .lt. 0 .and. norm_corr*3 .lt. -epsi) then
2411 epsi = -3*norm_corr
2412 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) 'Warning changing epsi on the fly =', epsi
2413 end if
2414 end if
2415 ! endif
2416
2417 ! if(parcut.gt.0) then
2418 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' I consider # ', numpar, 'independent param. '
2419
2420 if (np .gt. ncg) then
2421 if (ncg .gt. 0) then
2422 call dgemv('T', ncg, npr, 1.d0, reduce, ncg, psip, 1, 0.d0, psip(n2), 1)
2423 else
2424 call dscalzero(npr, 0.d0, psip(n2), 1)
2425 end if
2426
2427 do jj = ncg + 1, np
2428 indscali = ipip(n3 + jj - 1)
2429 ! write(6,*) ' before =',jj,indscali,psip(n2+indscali-1),psip(jj)
2430 psip(n2 + indscali - 1) = psip(n2 + indscali - 1) + psip(jj)
2431 end do
2432 else
2433 call dgemv('T', np, npr, 1.d0, reduce, ncg, psip, 1, 0.d0, psip(n2), 1)
2434 end if
2435 call dcopy(npr, psip(n2), 1, psip, 1)
2436 if (idyn .eq. 0 .and. ieskin .ne. 0 .and. signalnoise) then
2437 cost = tjas*dnrm2(ieskin, psip(npr - ieskin + 1), 1)
2438 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Norm change ions =', cost
2439 if (cost .gt. abs(epsi) .and. epsi .ne. 0) then
2440 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Warning decelerated ions by ', epsi/cost
2441 cost = abs(epsi)/cost
2442 psip(npr - ieskin + 1:npr) = cost*psip(npr - ieskin + 1:npr)
2443 end if
2444 end if
2445 ! write(6,*) ' Direction chosen '
2446 ! do i=1,npr
2447 ! write(6,*) i,psip(i)
2448 ! enddo
2449 np = npr
2450 npp = npr + 1
2451 ! endif
2452 end if
2453
2454 if (info .ne. 0) then
2455 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Warning info =', info
2456 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) 'Continuing with previous param. !!!'
2457 call dscalzero(np, 0.d0, psip, 1)
2458 end if
2459
2460 ! Now rescaling of the solution found
2461 !if(rank.eq.0) write(6,*) ' Correction found '
2462 do j = 1, np
2463 alpha(j) = psip(j)
2464 !if(rank.eq.0) write(6,*) j,psip(j)
2465 end do
2466 ! stop
2467
2468 alpha(npp) = 1.d0
2469
2470 ! endif ! rank.eq.0
2471
2472 ! This change has to be put after the if rank==0, otherwise only the
2473 ! master makes the change.
2474 if (idyn .gt. 0 .and. stepcg_recount) then
2475 stepcg = 0
2476 reduce(1:ncg, 1:np) = 0.d0
2477 end if
2478#ifdef PARALLEL
2479 call mpi_bcast(errnoise, 1, mpi_integer, 0, commopt_mpi, ierr)
2480#endif
2481 if (errnoise .ne. 0) then
2482
2483 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Error in reweight0 =', errnoise
2484
2485#ifdef PARALLEL
2486 call mpi_finalize(ierr)
2487#endif
2488
2489 stop
2490
2491 end if
2492
2493#ifdef PARALLEL
2494 if (.not. yesquantum) then
2495 call bcast_real(alpha, npr, 0, commsr_mpi) ! the maximum communication as commsr_mpi>=commopt_mpi
2496 else
2497 call bcast_real(alpha, npk, 0, commopt_mpi)
2498 if (yescomm) then
2499 call bcast_real(alpha(npk + 1), ieskin, 0, commrep_mpi)
2500 end if
2501 end if ! endif yesquantum
2502!$omp barrier
2503#endif
2504
2505 if (idyn .gt. 2) deallocate (vel0)
2506 if (allocated(forza_sav)) then
2507 call dcopy(npr, forza_sav, 1, forza, 1)
2508 deallocate (forza_sav)
2509 end if
2510
2511 end if ! fine if iweight
2512
2513 end if ! fine if np > 0
2514
2515 return
2516

2519#else
2520123 format(1000000e15.7)
2521#endif

2525 !> @brief Updates indices for complex parameters in quantum Monte Carlo calculations
2526 !>
2527 !> This subroutine handles the indexing of complex parameters, including:
2528 !> - Setting up arrays for tracking complex parameters
2529 !> - Handling real and imaginary parts of parameters
2530 !> - Managing symmetry-related parameters
2531 !> - Updating indices for modulus one parameters
2532 !>
2533 !> @note The subroutine uses global variables and arrays defined in the module scope
2534 subroutine update_index
2535 implicit none
2536 kp_complex = 0
2537 if (srcomplex .and. .not. signalnoise) then
2538 allocate (index(kp_ion), truecomplex(kp_ion), type_complex(npk))
2539 truecomplex = .false. ! Only the first real element of the complex
2540 type_complex = 0
2541 ! type_complex=0 real parameter
2542 ! type_complex=1 real or imaginary parameter of the normal type
2543 ! namely the associated complex operator O_R +i O_I is determined by
2544 ! type_complex(ind) --> econf(ind)-i econf(ind+1)
2545 ! type_complex=2 imaginary parameter constructed with Cauchy
2546 ! type_complex(ind) --> econf(ind)+i econf(ind-1)
2547 index = 0
2548 ku_ion = 0
2549 if (symmagp .and. yes_correct) then
2550 ! First the complex parameters
2551 do i = ndimjp, ndims, 4
2552 type_complex(i) = 1
2553 type_complex(i + 2) = 1
2554 if (rpar(i) .eq. 0 .and. allowed_par(i) .and. allowed_par(i + 2)) then
2555 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2556 index(ku_ion) = i
2557 ! if(rank.eq.0) write(6,*) ' touched parameter =',i
2558 truecomplex(ku_ion) = .true.
2559 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2560 index(ku_ion) = i + 1 ! imaginary part
2561 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2562 truecomplex(ku_ion) = .true.
2563 index(ku_ion) = i + 2
2564 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2565 index(ku_ion) = i + 3 ! imaginary part
2566 ! if(rank.eq.0) write(6,*) ' touched parameter =',i
2567 end if
2568 end do
2569 do i = ndimsp, kp0, 2
2570 type_complex(i) = 1
2571 if (rpar(i) .eq. 0 .and. allowed_par(i)) then
2572 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2573 index(ku_ion) = i
2574 truecomplex(ku_ion) = .true.
2575 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2576 index(ku_ion) = i + 1 ! Imaginary part
2577 ! if(rank.eq.0) write(6,*) ' touched parameter =',i
2578 end if
2579 end do
2580 ! Now the modulus one determined by sjbradet, again with real and imag part for the forces.
2581 do i = ndimjp, ndims, 4
2582 if (rpar(i) .eq. 0 .and. allowed_par(i) .and. .not. allowed_par(i + 2)) then
2583 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2584 truecomplex(ku_ion) = .true.
2585 index(ku_ion) = i
2586 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2587 index(ku_ion) = i + 1 ! the imaginary part
2588 ! if(rank.eq.0) write(6,*) ' touched parameter =',i
2589 end if
2590 end do
2591 else
2592 do i = ndimjp, kp0, 2
2593 type_complex(i) = 1
2594 type_complex(i + 1) = 2
2595 if (rpar(i) .eq. 0 .and. allowed_par(i)) then
2596 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2597 index(ku_ion) = i
2598 ! if(rank.eq.0) write(6,*) ' touched parameter =',i
2599 truecomplex(ku_ion) = .true.
2600 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2601 index(ku_ion) = i + 1 ! the imaginary part is always needed
2602 ! if(rank.eq.0) write(6,*) ' touched parameter =',i
2603 end if
2604 end do
2605 end if
2606 kp_complex = ku_ion ! The last complex parameter
2607 do i = 1, ndimj
2608 if (rpar(i) .eq. 0 .and. allowed_par(i)) then
2609 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2610 index(ku_ion) = i
2611 ! if(rank.eq.0) write(6,*) ' touched parameter =',i
2612 end if
2613 end do
2614 else
2615 if (signalnoise .and. idyn .eq. 0) kp_ion = npr
2616 allocate (index(kp_ion))
2617 allocate (type_complex(npk))
2618 type_complex = 0 ! simple real
2619 ! only the parameters allowed by the cutoff are moved
2620 index = 0
2621 ku_ion = 0
2622 if (ipc .eq. 2) then
2623 if (symmagp .and. yes_correct) then
2624
2625 do i = ndimjp, ndims, 4
2626 if (.not. signalnoise) then
2627 type_complex(i) = 1
2628 type_complex(i + 2) = 1
2629 end if
2630 if (rpar(i) .eq. 0) then
2631 if (allowed_par(i)) then
2632 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2633 index(ku_ion) = i
2634 end if
2635 if (allowed_par(i + 2)) then
2636 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2637 index(ku_ion) = i + 2
2638 end if
2639 end if
2640 end do
2641 do i = ndimsp, kp0, 2
2642 if (.not. signalnoise) then
2643 type_complex(i) = 1
2644 end if
2645 if (rpar(i) .eq. 0 .and. allowed_par(i)) then
2646 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2647 index(ku_ion) = i
2648 end if
2649 end do
2650 else
2651 do i = ndimjp, kp0, 2
2652 if (.not. signalnoise) then
2653 type_complex(i) = 1
2654 type_complex(i + 1) = 2
2655 end if
2656 if (rpar(i) .eq. 0) then
2657 if (allowed_par(i)) then
2658 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2659 index(ku_ion) = i
2660 end if
2661 if (allowed_par(i + 1)) then
2662 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2663 index(ku_ion) = i + 1
2664 end if
2665 end if
2666 end do
2667 end if
2668 do i = 1, ndimj
2669 if (rpar(i) .eq. 0 .and. allowed_par(i)) then
2670 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2671 index(ku_ion) = i
2672 ! if(rank.eq.0) write(6,*) ' touched parameter =',i
2673 end if
2674 end do
2675
2676 else
2677 do i = 1, kp0
2678 if (rpar(i) .eq. 0 .and. allowed_par(i)) then
2679 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2680 index(ku_ion) = i
2681 end if
2682 end do
2683 end if
2684 end if
2685 if (signalnoise .and. idyn .eq. 0) then
2686 do i = kp0 + 1, kp0 + ieskin
2687 if (allowed_par(i)) then
2688 ku_ion = ku_ion + 1
2689 index(ku_ion) = i
2690 else
2691 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Warning untouched ion parameter =', i
2692 end if
2693 end do
2694 end if
2695
2696 k_par = ku_ion
2697 ku_ionp = ku_ion + 1
2698 if (rank .eq. 0) then
2699 if (symmagp .or. kp_complex .eq. 0) then
2700 write (6, *) ' Leading dimension matrix =', ku_ion - kp_complex/2
2701 else
2702 if (real_agp) then
2703 write (6, *) ' Leading dimension matrix =', ku_ion - kp_complex/2
2704 else
2705 write (6, *) ' Leading dimension matrix =', ku_ion
2706 end if
2707 end if
2708 end if
2709
2710#ifdef PARALLEL
2711#ifdef UNREL_DIAG
2712 if (srcomplex .and. .not. signalnoise) then
2713 call mpi_bcast(truecomplex, kp_ion, mpi_logical, 0, commsr_mpi, ierr)
2714 end if
2715 call mpi_bcast(index, kp_ion, mpi_integer, 0, commsr_mpi, ierr)
2716 call mpi_bcast(kp_complex, 1, mpi_integer, 0, commsr_mpi, ierr)
2717 call mpi_bcast(type_complex, npk, mpi_integer1, 0, commsr_mpi, ierr)
2718#endif
2719#endif
2720 end subroutine update_index
2721
2722 !> @brief Handles ion dynamics calculations and updates
2723 !>
2724 !> This subroutine performs ion dynamics calculations including:
2725 !> - Rescaling solutions and calculating dynamics ratios
2726 !> - Allocating and initializing work arrays (sov4, sov5)
2727 !> - Handling ion movement based on dynamics mode (idyn)
2728 !> - Managing quantum and classical dynamics
2729 !> - Updating ion positions and velocities
2730 !>
2731 !> @note Uses global variables and arrays defined in module scope
2732 !> @note Requires temperature (temp) and time step (dtr) to be set
2733 !> @note Handles both classical and quantum dynamics modes
2734 subroutine ion_dynamics
2735
2736 ! by E. Coccia (18/1/11)
2737 use extpot, only: ext_pot
2738
2739 implicit none
2740 real*8 drand1, dnrm2, costm1, costhm1, trace, ratio_dyn, all_dyn
2741 integer indm, i, j, ind, i_ion, k_ion
2742 real*8, dimension(:, :), allocatable :: sov4, sov5
2743 ! BEGIN ION DYNAMICS
2744
2745 ! write(6,*) ' sov =',ndsr,indin,sov(1,1,4),psip(indin)
2746
2747 ! call dgetrf(ndsr,ndsr,sov(indin,indin,4),npm,ipip(n4),info)
2748
2749 ! call dgetrs('N',ndsr,1,sov(indin,indin,4),npp,ipip(n4)
2750 ! 1,psip(indin),ndsr,info)
2751
2752 ! rescaling the solution
2753 ! write(6,*) ' sr inside '
2754 ratio_dyn = 0.d0
2755 all_dyn = 0.d0
2756
2757 ! write(6,*) ' DTR/Temp inside =',dtr,temp
2758 if (idyn .ge. 2 .and. idyn .le. 4 .or. idyn .eq. 6 .or. idyn .eq. 7 .or. idyn .eq. 8) then
2759 allocate (sov4(npp, 2))
2760 sov4 = 0.d0
2761 end if
2762 if (yesturboq .or. idyn .eq. 7) then
2763 allocate (sov5(ieskin, 7))
2764 sov5 = 0.d0
2765 elseif (idyn .eq. 5 .and. yesquantum) then
2766 allocate (sov5(ieskin, 5))
2767 sov5 = 0.d0
2768 end if
2769 n3n = 3*nion

3286 else
3287 ! for numerical stability
3288 costm1 = -dt*psip(i) + (dt*psip(i))**2/2.d0
3289 costhm1 = -dt*psip(i)/2 + (dt*psip(i))**2/8.d0
3290 end if
3291 mnoise(1, 1) = -psip(i)*temp*psip(i)* &
3292 & (1.d0 + cost)/costm1 - alphaqmc
3293 gn = -costm1/psip(i)
3294
3295 tn = 1.d0/psip(i)*(dt + costh/psip(i)*costm1)
3296
3297 mnoise(2, 2) = alphaall/tn**2* &
3298 &(dt/psip(i)**2 + 0.5d0/psip(i)**3*(2.d0 - cost)*costm1*(1.d0 + cost))&
3299 & - alphaqmc
3300
3301 mnoise(1, 2) = alphaall/(tn*2.d0*psip(i)*(1.d0 + costh))* &
3302 & (2.d0 - cost*costh*costm1/costhm1) - alphaqmc
3303
3304 mnoise(2, 1) = mnoise(1, 2)
3305
3306 ! make a square root of a positive definite matrix to define the noise.
3307 all_dyn = all_dyn + mnoise(1, 1) + mnoise(2, 2)
3308 ratio_dyn = ratio_dyn + 2*alphaqmc
3309
3310 call root2mat(mnoise, errnoise)
3311
3312 else
3313 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' ERROR negative eigenv. ', psip(i) &
3314 &, alphaqmc
3315 errnoise = 1
3316 end if !if psip(i).gt.0
3317
3318 if (rank .eq. 0 .and. errnoise .ne. 0) write (6, *) ' Error negative noise matrix !!!'
3319
3320 eta_v = mnoise(1, 1)*zetan(1) + mnoise(1, 2)*zetan(2)
3321 eta_r = mnoise(2, 1)*zetan(1) + mnoise(2, 2)*zetan(2)
3322
3323 ! Now the consistent change of coordinates put in velion(1,*)
3324 velion(1, i) = sov4(i, 1)*costh*gn + tn*(velion(2, i) + eta_r)
3325
3326 velion(2, i) = sov4(i, 1)*cost + gn*(velion(2, i) + eta_v)
3327
3328 end do
3329#ifdef DEBUG
3330 velion(1:2, 1:3) = 0.d0
3331 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' changed velocities 2 ',&
3332 &sum(velion(2, 1:ieskin)), sum(velion(1, 1:ieskin))
3333 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' changed velocities squares 2 ',&
3334 &sum(velion(2, 1:ieskin)**2), sum(velion(1, 1:ieskin)**2)
3335#endif
3336
3337 ! Now go back to the original basis
3338 call dgemv('N', ieskin, ieskin, 1.d0, cov, ieskin &
3339 &, velion(2, 1), 3, 0.d0, velion(3, 1), 3)
3340 call dgemv('N', ieskin, ieskin, 1.d0, cov, ieskin &
3341 &, velion(1, 1), 3, 0.d0, psip(n2 + indi), 1)
3342
3343 ! back to the scale of coordinates
3344 ! write(6,*) ' Final correction inside '
3345 cost = 0.d0
3346 do i = 1, ieskin
3347 psip(n2 + indi + i - 1) = psip(n2 + indi + i - 1)*psip(n3 + i - 1)
3348 if (psip(n3 + i - 1) .ne. 0.d0) then
3349 cost = cost + 1.d0
3350 else
3351 velion(3, i) = 0.d0
3352 end if
3353 ! write(6,*) i,psip(n2+indi+i-1),psip(n3+i-1),velion(3,i)
3354 end do
3355 tmes = dnrm2(ieskin, velion(3, 1), 3)**2/cost*ris(2)
3356 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Temperature (H)= ', tmes
3357 cost = dnrm2(ieskin, psip(n2 + indi), 1)
3358 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Norm change ions =', cost
3359
3360 !!!! FINE NEW DYN
3361 elseif (idyn .eq. 7) then
3362
3363 ! In this routine we apply the Trotter in the Master equation according to
3364 ! Ceriotti's paper. Thus we first apply the idyn=3 scheme by changing only
3365 ! the velocities and without moving the ions, with the covariance matrix
3366 ! defined for each bead independently.
3367 ! Then we apply the exact damped dynamic for the elastic quantum case
3368 ! without any force.
3369 if (yesrootc) then
3370 cost = (delta0/2.d0)**2
3371 else
3372 if (temp .ne. 0.d0) then
3373 cost = delta0*0.5d0/temp
3374 else
3375 cost = 0.d0
3376 end if
3377 end if
3378
3379 call dscal(ieskin2, cost, cov, 1)
3380
3381 if (yessecond) then
3382 dth = dt/2.d0
3383 else
3384 dth = dt
3385 end if
3386
3387 indin = 0
3388 do j = npps, np
3389 indin = indin + 1
3390 psip(n3 + indin - 1) = dsqrt(scalpar(ipip(n3 + j - 1))/dt)
3391 end do
3392
3393 if (indin .ne. ieskin) then
3394 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Error in dynamic ieskin ne indin !!! ', ieskin, indin
3395 errnoise = 6
3396 end if
3397
3398 do j = 1, ieskin
3399 do i = 1, ieskin
3400 cov(ieskin*(j - 1) + i) = cov(ieskin*(j - 1) + i)*psip(n3 + i - 1)*psip(n3 + j - 1)
3401 end do
3402 end do
3403
3404 ! first diagonalize sov(1,1,4)
3405 ! save psip the QMC forces
3406 call dcopy(np, psip, 1, sov4(1, 2), 1)
3407 ! scale the force by the Mass
3408 do i = 1, ieskin
3409 sov4(indi + i, 2) = sov4(indi + i, 2)*psip(n3 + i - 1)
3410 end do
3411
3412 ! do i=1,ieskin
3413 ! cov(ieskin*(i-1)+i)=cov(ieskin*(i-1)+i)+friction
3414 ! enddo
3415
3416 lworkd = 3*ieskin
3417
3418 ! if((yesquantum.and.nrep_bead.gt.1)) then
3419 call dsyev_my('V', 'L', ieskin, cov, ieskin, psip, info, nprocrep, rankrep, commrep_mpi)
3420 ! else
3421 ! call dsyev('V','L',ieskin,cov,ieskin,psip,psip(n5),lworkd,info)
3422 ! endif
3423 if (yesrootc) then
3424 psip(i) = dsqrt(max(psip(i), 0.d0)) + friction
3425 else
3426 do i = 1, ieskin
3427 psip(i) = psip(i) + friction
3428 end do
3429 end if
3430
3431 if (rank .eq. 0) then
3432 write (6, *) ' Eigenvalues covariance '
3433 do i = 1, ieskin
3434 write (6, *) i, psip(i)
3435 end do
3436 end if
3437#ifdef DEBUG
3438! Z2 Gauge fixing
3439 do i = 1, ieskin
3440 cost = abs(cov(ieskin*(i - 1) + 1))
3441 indm = 1
3442 do j = 2, ieskin
3443 if (abs(cov(ieskin*(i - 1) + j)) .gt. cost) then
3444 cost = abs(cov(ieskin*(i - 1) + j))
3445 indm = j
3446 end if
3447 end do
3448 if (cov(indm + (i - 1)*ieskin) .lt. 0.d0) cov(1 + ieskin*(i - 1):ieskin*i)&
3449 & = -cov(1 + ieskin*(i - 1):ieskin*i)
3450 end do
3451#endif
3452
3453 if (info .ne. 0) then
3454 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Error in lapack dsyev dynamic !!! '
3455 errnoise = 4
3456 end if
3457
3458 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Ratio dyn =', (psip(ieskin) - friction)/sqrt(temp*157.8873306d0)
3459
3460 do i = 1, ieskin
3461 if (psip(i) .gt. 0.d0) then
3462 psip(n5 + i - 1) = (1.d0 - dexp(-psip(i)*dth))/psip(i)
3463 else
3464 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Refused eigenvalue ', i
3465 psip(n5 + i - 1) = dth
3466 end if
3467 end do
3468 ! compute the noise correction
3469 alphaqmc = 0.d0
3470
3471 do i = 1, ieskin
3472 if (psip(i) .gt. 0.d0) then
3473 ! psip(n4+i-1)=(psip(i)*2.d0*temp)*psip(i)*
3474 ! 1 sinh(dt*psip(i))/(4.d0*sinh(psip(i)*dt*.5d0)**2)
3475 ! the following is protected for overflow
3476 cost = exp(-dth*psip(i))
3477 if (delta0 .ne. 0.d0 .and. normcorr .gt. 0.d0) then
3478 if (yesrootc) then
3479 alphaqmc = normcorr*(2.d0*(psip(i) - friction)/delta0)**2
3480 else
3481 alphaqmc = normcorr*2.d0*temp*(psip(i) - friction)/delta0
3482 end if
3483 else
3484 alphaqmc = 0.d0
3485 end if
3486 psip(n4 + i - 1) = psip(i)*temp*psip(i)* &
3487 & (1.d0 + cost)/(1.d0 - cost) - alphaqmc
3488 ! subtracting the noise already present in the forces
3489 else
3490 psip(n4 + i - 1) = 0.d0
3491 end if
3492 all_dyn = all_dyn + psip(n4 + i - 1) + alphaqmc
3493 ratio_dyn = ratio_dyn + alphaqmc
3494
3495 if (psip(n4 + i - 1) .gt. 0.d0) then
3496 psip(n4 + i - 1) = dsqrt(psip(n4 + i - 1))
3497 else
3498
3499 psip(n4 + i - 1) = 0.d0
3500 if (yesrootc) write (6, *) ' Warning noise correction not possible ', i, psip(i), psip(n4 + i - 1)
3501 if (friction .gt. 0.d0 .and. .not. yesrootc) then
3502 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' There should be some error in reweight0 &
3503 & ', i, psip(n4 + i - 1)
3504 errnoise = 5
3505 end if
3506 end if
3507 end do
3508
3509 ! now we are able to update the velocity
3510 ! first change basis actual velocity and force
3511 call dgemv('T', ieskin, ieskin, 1.d0, cov, ieskin &
3512 &, velion(3, 1), 3, 0.d0, sov4, 1)
3513 call dgemv('T', ieskin, ieskin, 1.d0, cov, ieskin &
3514 &, sov4(indi + 1, 2), 1, 0.d0, velion(2, 1), 3)
3515
3516 if (yessecond) then
3517 ! Compute the temperature at half time intervals.
3518 do i = 1, ieskin
3519 zeta = dsqrt(-2.d0*dlog(1.d0 - drand1()))*dcos(2.d0*pi*drand1())
3520 sov4(i, 1) = sov4(i, 1)*dexp(-psip(i)*dth) &
3521 & + psip(n5 + i - 1)*(velion(2, i) + psip(n4 + i - 1)*zeta)
3522 end do
3523 tmes = dnrm2(ieskin, sov4, 1)**2/ieskin*ris(2)
3524 ! Second half time interval.
3525 do i = 1, ieskin
3526 zeta = dsqrt(-2.d0*dlog(1.d0 - drand1()))*dcos(2.d0*pi*drand1())
3527 velion(2, i) = sov4(i, 1)*dexp(-psip(i)*dth) &
3528 & + psip(n5 + i - 1)*(velion(2, i) + psip(n4 + i - 1)*zeta)
3529 end do
3530 else
3531 do i = 1, ieskin
3532 zeta = dsqrt(-2.d0*dlog(1.d0 - drand1()))*dcos(2.d0*pi*drand1())
3533 velion(2, i) = sov4(i, 1)*dexp(-psip(i)*dth) &
3534 & + psip(n5 + i - 1)*(velion(2, i) + psip(n4 + i - 1)*zeta)
3535 end do
3536 end if
3537
3538 ! go back in the original basis
3539
3540 call dgemv('N', ieskin, ieskin, 1.d0, cov, ieskin &
3541 &, velion(2, 1), 3, 0.d0, velion(3, 1), 3)
3542
3543 if (.not. yessecond) tmes = dnrm2(ieskin, velion(3, 1), 3)**2/ieskin*ris(2)
3544 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Temperature (H)= ', tmes
3545
3546 ! call dgemv('T',ieskin,ieskin,1.d0,cov,ieskin &
3547 ! &,velion(3,1),3,0.d0,sov4,1)
3548 ! call dgemv('T',ieskin,ieskin,1.d0,cov,ieskin &
3549 ! &,sov4(indi+1,2),1,0.d0,velion(2,1),3)
3550
3551 ! cov is the identity for idyn==7
3552
3553 ! call dcopy(ieskin,sov4(indi+1,2),1,velion(2,1),3)
3554 velion(2, 1:ieskin) = 0.d0 ! no forces here
3555 call dcopy(ieskin, velion(3, 1), 3, sov4, 1)
3556 ! Here sov4(*,1) contains the transfomed velocities
3557 ! velion(2,*) the transformed forces
3558 ! In the following velion(1,*) is unchanged
3559
3560 ! Transformation coordinates in the basis of eigenvectors
3561 ! velion(1,*) represents run time the difference between the atomic position
3562 ! when the forces are computed and the coordinates when we start to apply
3563 ! the new LD integrator. velion(1,*) is non zero only for second order
3564 ! dynamics (yessecond), more accurate with the time step integration.
3565 ! Notice that, after that, we have to scale by the sqrt of the mass (psip(n3)~1/sqrt(m))
3566 do j = 1, nion
3567 do i = 1, 3
3568 ind = i + (j - 1)*3
3569 sov5(ind, 4) = rion(i, j)/psip(n3 + ind - 1)
3570 end do
3571 end do
3572#ifdef PARALLEL
3573! In the quantum case we have also to apply the transformation kdyn that
3574! diagonalizes the interaction between the beads. Since each bead is in a
3575! different processor, this trasformation is done in parallel only
3576! kdyn matrix elements are common to all processors.
3577 do i = 0, nbead - 1
3578 sov5(1:ieskin, 1) = kdyn(rankcolrep + 1, i + 1)*sov4(1:ieskin, 1) ! velocities
3579! sov5(1:ieskin,2)=kdyn(rankcolrep+1,i+1)*velion(2,1:ieskin) ! forces
3580 sov5(1:ieskin, 2) = kdyn(rankcolrep + 1, i + 1)*sov5(1:ieskin, 4) ! coordinates
3581 call reduce_base_real_to(2*ieskin, sov5, sov5(1, 6), commcolrep_mpi, i)
3582 end do
3583 sov4(1:ieskin, 1) = sov5(1:ieskin, 6)
3584! velion(2,*) is actually zero below
3585#endif
3586#ifdef DEBUG
3587 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' changed velocities ',&
3588 &sum(velion(2, 4:ieskin)), sum(sov4(4:ieskin, 1))
3589 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' changed velocities squares ',&
3590 &sum(velion(2, 4:ieskin)**2), sum(sov4(4:ieskin, 1)**2)
3591#endif
3592 alphaqmc = 0.d0
3593 !!!! INIZIO NEW DYN : Now everything is in the diagonal basis and the integration
3594 !can be done exactly for each of the ieskin (x nbead , index labelled by
3595 ! rankcolrep+1 in the quantum case) eigenvalues
3596
3597#ifdef DEBUG
3598 do i = 4, ieskin
3599#else
3600 do i = 1, ieskin
3601#endif
3602 zetan(1) = dsqrt(-2.d0*dlog(1.d0 - drand1()))*dcos(2.d0*pi*drand1())
3603 zetan(2) = dsqrt(-2.d0*dlog(1.d0 - drand1()))*dcos(2.d0*pi*drand1())
3604
3605 alphaqmc = 0.d0
3606 alphaall = 0.d0
3607
3608 ! gammaall
3609 psip(i) = 2.d0*delta0k*sqrt(abs(kdyn_eig(rankcolrep + 1)))
3610 if (psip(i) .lt. delta0q) psip(i) = delta0q ! cutoff on the lowest eigenvalue. Ceriotti's choice.
3611
3612 alphaall = 2*temp*psip(i)
3613
3614 call set_turboq(psip(i), kdyn_eig(rankcolrep + 1), dt&
3615 &, alphaall, alphaqmc, mnoise, gn, tn, gni, gnh, gnih)
3616
3617 gnh = 0.d0
3618 gnih = 0.d0
3619
3620 call root2mat(mnoise, errnoise)
3621
3622 if (errnoise .ne. 0 .and. rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Error negative definite matrix noise '
3623
3624 eta_v = mnoise(1, 1)*zetan(1) + mnoise(1, 2)*zetan(2)
3625 eta_r = mnoise(2, 1)*zetan(1) + mnoise(2, 2)*zetan(2)
3626
3627 ! Now the consistent change of coordinates put in velion(1,*)
3628 ! velion(3,*) represents an extra displacement of the positions by dt/2 without the noise
3629 ! and the force (Gn=0), i.e. consistent up to order dt^3/2.
3630
3631 sov4(i, 2) = sov4(i, 1)*gni(2, 1) + gni(2, 2)*sov5(i, 7) + tn*eta_r
3632 velion(2, i) = sov4(i, 1)*gni(1, 1) + gni(1, 2)*sov5(i, 7) + gn*eta_v
3633
3634 end do
3635#ifdef DEBUG
3636 velion(1:2, 1:3) = 0.d0
3637 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' changed velocities 2 ',&
3638 &sum(velion(2, 1:ieskin)), sum(velion(1, 1:ieskin))
3639 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' changed velocities squares 2 ',&
3640 &sum(velion(2, 1:ieskin)**2), sum(velion(1, 1:ieskin)**2)
3641#endif
3642 ! Now go back to the original basis
3643 ! Tmes=dnrm2(ieskin,velion,3)**2/ieskin*ris(2)
3644 ! call reduce_base_real(1,Tmes,commcolrep_mpi,-1)
3645 ! if(rank.eq.0) write(6,*) ' sum after0',Tmes/nbead
3646 ! Transformation back in the original basis
3647#ifdef PARALLEL
3648 do i = 0, nbead - 1
3649 sov5(1:ieskin, 1) = kdyn(i + 1, rankcolrep + 1)*sov4(1:ieskin, 2) ! coordinates
3650 sov5(1:ieskin, 2) = kdyn(i + 1, rankcolrep + 1)*velion(2, 1:ieskin) ! velocities
3651! sov5(1:ieskin,3)=kdyn(i+1,rankcolrep+1)*velion(3,1:ieskin) ! extra prop coordinates
3652 call reduce_base_real_to(2*ieskin, sov5, sov5(1, 4), commcolrep_mpi, i)
3653 end do
3654 sov4(1:ieskin, 2) = sov5(1:ieskin, 4)
3655 velion(2, 1:ieskin) = sov5(1:ieskin, 5)
3656! velion(3,1:ieskin)=sov5(1:ieskin,6)
3657! Tmes=dnrm2(ieskin,velion,3)**2/ieskin*ris(2)
3658! call reduce_base_real(1,Tmes,commcolrep_mpi,-1)
3659! if(rank.eq.0) write(6,*) ' sum after1',Tmes/nbead
3660#endif
3661
3662 ! call dgemv('N',ieskin,ieskin,1.d0,cov,ieskin &
3663 ! &,velion(3,1),3,0.d0,sov4,1)
3664 ! call dcopy(ieskin,velion(3,1),3,sov4,1)
3665 ! call dgemv('N',ieskin,ieskin,1.d0,cov,ieskin &
3666 ! &,velion(2,1),3,0.d0,velion(3,1),3)
3667 call dcopy(ieskin, velion(2, 1), 3, velion(3, 1), 3)
3668 ! call dgemv('N',ieskin,ieskin,1.d0,cov,ieskin &
3669 ! &,sov4(1,2),1,0.d0,psip(n2+indi),1)
3670 call dcopy(ieskin, sov4(1, 2), 1, psip(n2 + indi), 1)
3671
3672 ! back to the scale of coordinates
3673 ! write(6,*) ' Final correction inside '
3674 do i = 1, ieskin
3675 psip(n2 + indi + i - 1) = psip(n2 + indi + i - 1)*psip(n3 + i - 1)
3676 if (psip(n3 + i - 1) .eq. 0.d0) then
3677 velion(3, i) = 0.d0
3678 end if
3679 end do
3680 cost = dnrm2(ieskin, psip(n2 + indi), 1)
3681 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Norm change ions =', cost
3682
3683 !!!! FINE NEW IDYN=7 !!!!!
3684
3685 elseif (idyn .eq. 8) then !!! Bare Ceriotti algorithm
3686
3687 if (temp .ne. 0.d0) then
3688 cost = delta0*0.5d0/temp
3689 else
3690 cost = 0.d0
3691 end if
3692
3693 dth = dt/2.d0
3694
3695 call dscal(ieskin2, cost, cov, 1)
3696
3697 indin = 0
3698 do j = npps, np
3699 indin = indin + 1
3700 ! scaling as 1/sqrt(m)
3701 psip(n3 + indin - 1) = dsqrt(scalpar(ipip(n3 + j - 1))/dt)
3702 end do
3703
3704 ! rescale the covariance matrix by masses
3705 do j = 1, ieskin
3706 do i = 1, ieskin
3707 cov(ieskin*(j - 1) + i) = cov(ieskin*(j - 1) + i)*psip(n3 + i - 1)*psip(n3 + j - 1)
3708 end do
3709 end do
3710
3711 ! scale the force by the Mass
3712 call dcopy(np, psip, 1, sov4(1, 2), 1) ! forces stored in sov4(1:ieskin,2)
3713 do i = 1, ieskin
3714 sov4(indi + i, 2) = sov4(indi + i, 2)*psip(n3 + i - 1)
3715 end do
3716
3717 ! add diagonal term to covariance
3718 do i = 1, ieskin
3719 cov(ieskin*(i - 1) + i) = cov(ieskin*(i - 1) + i) + friction
3720 end do
3721
3722 ! Save covariance matrix before it is destroyed by diagonalization
3723 cov_sav(1:ieskin*ieskin) = cov(1:ieskin*ieskin)
3724
3725 ! diagonalize gamma matrix in the physical bead space stored in cov
3726 ! lworkd=3*ieskin
3727
3728 ! previous version
3729 ! call dsyev_my('V','L',ieskin,cov,ieskin,psip,psip(n5) &
3730 ! ,lworkd,info,nprocrep,rankrep,commrep_mpi)
3731
3732 ! WARNING: mind that in the latest version dsyev_my has changed!!!!!!
3733 ! Use the following one instead
3734 call dsyev_my('V', 'L', ieskin, cov, ieskin, psip, info, nprocrep, rankrep, commrep_mpi)
3735
3736 if (rank .eq. 0) then
3737 write (6, *) ' Eigenvalues covariance '
3738 do i = 1, ieskin
3739 write (6, *) i, psip(i)
3740 end do
3741 end if
3742#ifdef DEBUG
3743 ! Z2 Gauge fixing
3744 do i = 1, ieskin
3745 cost = abs(cov(ieskin*(i - 1) + 1))
3746 indm = 1
3747 do j = 2, ieskin
3748 if (abs(cov(ieskin*(i - 1) + j)) .gt. cost) then
3749 cost = abs(cov(ieskin*(i - 1) + j))
3750 indm = j
3751 end if
3752 end do
3753 if (cov(indm + (i - 1)*ieskin) .lt. 0.d0) cov(1 + ieskin*(i - 1):ieskin*i)&
3754 & = -cov(1 + ieskin*(i - 1):ieskin*i)
3755 end do
3756#endif
3757
3758 if (info .ne. 0) then
3759 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Error in lapack dsyev dynamic !!! ', info
3760 errnoise = 4
3761 end if
3762
3763 ! The scale invariant criterium is gamma/sqrt(T) , so I have divided by the
3764 ! sqrt(T/T_0) where T_0=1000K
3765 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Ratio dyn =', (psip(ieskin) - friction)/sqrt(temp*157.8873306d0)
3766
3767 ! now compute coefficients as function of gamma eigenvalues
3768 do i = 1, ieskin
3769 if (psip(i) .gt. 0.d0) then
3770 psip(n5 + i - 1) = (1.d0 - dexp(-psip(i)*dth))/psip(i)
3771 else
3772 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Refused eigenvalue ', i
3773 psip(n5 + i - 1) = dth
3774 end if
3775 end do

3777 ! compute the noise correction
3778 alphaqmc = 0.d0
3779
3780 do i = 1, ieskin

3784 alphaqmc = normcorr*2.d0*temp*(psip(i) - friction)/delta0
3785 else
3786 alphaqmc = 0.d0
3787 end if
3788 psip(n4 + i - 1) = temp*psip(i)**2*(1.d0 + cost)/(1.d0 - cost) - alphaqmc
3789 ! subtracting the noise already present in the forces
3790 else
3791 psip(n4 + i - 1) = 0.d0
3792 end if
3793
3794 if (psip(n4 + i - 1) .gt. 0.d0) then
3795 psip(n4 + i - 1) = dsqrt(psip(n4 + i - 1))
3796 else
3797

3799 if (friction .gt. 0.d0) then
3800 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' There should be some error in reweight0', i, psip(n4 + i - 1)
3801 errnoise = 5
3802 end if
3803 end if
3804 end do

3806 ! now we are able to update the velocity

3808 call dgemv('T', ieskin, ieskin, 1.d0, cov, ieskin &
3809 , velion(3, 1), 3, 0.d0, sov4, 1)
3810 call dgemv('T', ieskin, ieskin, 1.d0, cov, ieskin &
3811 , sov4(indi + 1, 2), 1, 0.d0, velion(2, 1), 3)
3812

3814 do i = 1, ieskin

3816 sov4(i, 1) = sov4(i, 1)*dexp(-psip(i)*dth) &
3817 + psip(n5 + i - 1)*(velion(2, i) + psip(n4 + i - 1)*zeta)
3818 end do

3823 , sov4, 1, 0.d0, velion(3, 1), 3)

3855 zetan(1) = dsqrt(-2.d0*dlog(1.d0 - drand1()))*dcos(2.d0*pi*drand1())
3856

3867
3868 cost = exp(-dth*psip(i))

4069 sov4(i, 1) = sov4(i, 1)*dexp(-psip(i)*dth) &

4101 &*sov4(1:ieskin, 1) ! velocities

4326 ! Notice that, after that,
4327 ! we have to scale by the sqrt
4328 ! of the mass (psip(n3)~1/sqrt(m))
4329 do j = 1, nion
4330 do i = 1, 3
4331 ind = i + (j - 1)*3
4332 sov5(ind, 1) = (rion(i, j) - velion(1, ind))/psip(n3 + ind - 1)
4333 end do
4334 end do
4335 call dgemv('T', ieskin, ieskin, 1.d0, cov, ieskin &
4336 &, sov5, 1, 0.d0, sov5(1, 4), 1)
4337#ifdef PARALLEL
4338! In the quantum case we have also to apply the transformation kdyn that
4339! diagonalizes the interaction between the beads. Since each bead is in a
4340! different processor, this trasformation is done in parallel only
4341! kdyn matrix elements are common to all processors.
4342 do i = 0, nbead - 1
4343 ! velocities
4344 sov5(1:ieskin, 1) = kdyn(rankcolrep + 1, i + 1)*sov4(1:ieskin, 1)
4345 ! forces
4346 sov5(1:ieskin, 2) = kdyn(rankcolrep + 1, i + 1)*velion(2, 1:ieskin)
4347 ! coordinates
4348 sov5(1:ieskin, 3) = kdyn(rankcolrep + 1, i + 1)*sov5(1:ieskin, 4)
4349 call reduce_base_real_to(3*ieskin, sov5, sov5(1, 5)&
4350 &, commcolrep_mpi, i)
4351 end do
4352 sov4(1:ieskin, 1) = sov5(1:ieskin, 5)
4353 velion(2, 1:ieskin) = sov5(1:ieskin, 6)
4354#endif
4355 end if
4356#ifdef DEBUG
4357 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' changed velocities ',&
4358 &sum(velion(2, 4:ieskin)), sum(sov4(4:ieskin, 1))
4359 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' changed velocities squares ',&
4360 &sum(velion(2, 4:ieskin)**2), sum(sov4(4:ieskin, 1)**2)
4361#endif
4362 alphaqmc = 0.d0
4363 !!!! INIZIO NEW DYN : Now everything is in the diagonal basis and the integration
4364 !can be done exactly for each of the ieskin (x nbead , index labelled by
4365 ! rankcolrep+1 in the quantum case) eigenvalues
4366
4367#ifdef DEBUG
4368 do i = 4, ieskin
4369#else
4370 do i = 1, ieskin
4371#endif
4372 zetan(1) = dsqrt(-2.d0*dlog(1.d0 - drand1()))*dcos(2.d0*pi*drand1())
4373 zetan(2) = dsqrt(-2.d0*dlog(1.d0 - drand1()))*dcos(2.d0*pi*drand1())
4374
4375 if (psip(i) .gt. 0.d0) then
4376 if (delta0 .ne. 0.d0 .and. normcorr .gt. 0.d0) then
4377 if (yesrootc) then
4378 alphaqmc = normcorr*(2.d0*(psip(i) - friction)/delta0)**2
4379 else
4380 alphaqmc = 2.d0*normcorr*temp*(psip(i) - friction)/delta0
4381 end if
4382 else
4383 alphaqmc = 0.d0
4384 end if
4385 alphaall = 2.d0*temp*psip(i)
4386
4387 if (yesturboq) then
4388
4389 ! gammaall
4390 psip(i) = psip(i)&
4391 & + (psip(i) - friction)&
4392 & * delta0q*kdyn_eig(rankcolrep + 1) + &
4393 &2.d0*delta0k*sqrt(abs(kdyn_eig(rankcolrep + 1)))
4394
4395 alphaall = 2*temp*psip(i)
4396
4397 call set_turboq(psip(i), kdyn_eig(rankcolrep + 1), dt&
4398 &, alphaall, alphaqmc, mnoise, gn, tn, gni, gnh, gnih)
4399
4400 if (.not. yessecond) then
4401 gnh = 0.d0
4402 gnih = 0.d0
4403 end if
4404
4405 else
4406
4407 cost = exp(-dt*psip(i))
4408 if (cost .lt. 0.99999d0) then
4409 costm1 = cost - 1.d0
4410 else
4411 costm1 = -dt*psip(i) + (dt*psip(i))**2/2.d0
4412 end if
4413 costh = exp(-dth*psip(i))
4414 if (costh .lt. 0.99999d0) then
4415 costhm1 = costh - 1.d0
4416 else
4417 costhm1 = -dth*psip(i) + (dth*psip(i))**2/2.d0
4418 end if
4419
4420 gni(1, 1) = cost
4421 gn = -costm1/psip(i)
4422 if (yessecond) then
4423 gnh = -costhm1/psip(i)
4424 else
4425 gnh = 0.d0
4426 end if
4427 tn = 1.d0/psip(i)*(dt - gn)
4428
4429 mnoise(1, 1) = -alphaall/(2.d0*psip(i))*costm1*(1 + cost)
4430
4431 mnoise(2, 2) = alphaall/psip(i)**2* &
4432 &(dt + 1.d0/psip(i)&
4433 &*costm1*(2.d0 - 0.5d0*(1.d0 + cost)))
4434
4435 mnoise(1, 2) = 0.5d0*alphaall*(costm1/psip(i))**2
4436
4437 mnoise(1, 1) = mnoise(1, 1)/gn**2 - alphaqmc
4438 mnoise(2, 2) = mnoise(2, 2)/tn**2 - alphaqmc
4439 mnoise(1, 2) = mnoise(1, 2)/tn/gn - alphaqmc
4440
4441 mnoise(2, 1) = mnoise(1, 2)
4442
4443 end if
4444
4445 all_dyn = all_dyn + mnoise(1, 1) + mnoise(2, 2)
4446 ratio_dyn = ratio_dyn + 2*alphaqmc
4447
4448 call root2mat(mnoise, errnoise)
4449
4450 else
4451 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' ERROR negative eigenv. ', psip(i)&
4452 &, alphaqmc
4453 errnoise = 1
4454 end if !if psip(i).gt.0
4455
4456 if (errnoise .ne. 0 .and. rank .eq. 0) write (6, *)&
4457 & ' Error negative definite matrix noise '
4458
4459 eta_v = mnoise(1, 1)*zetan(1) + mnoise(1, 2)*zetan(2)
4460 eta_r = mnoise(2, 1)*zetan(1) + mnoise(2, 2)*zetan(2)
4461
4462 ! Now the consistent change of coordinates put in velion(1,*)
4463 ! velion(3,*) represents an extra
4464 ! displacement of the positions by dt/2 without the noise
4465 ! and the force (Gn=0), i.e. consistent up to order dt^3/2.
4466
4467 if (yesturboq) then
4468 sov4(i, 2) = sov4(i, 1)*gni(2, 1) + gni(2, 2)*sov5(i, 7)&
4469 & + tn*(velion(2, i) + eta_r)
4470 velion(2, i) = sov4(i, 1)*gni(1, 1) + gni(1, 2)*sov5(i, 7)&
4471 & + gn*(velion(2, i) + eta_v)
4472 ! Propagate further by half dt
4473 ! without noise and force, if necessary
4474 ! (yessecond=.true.) in terms
4475 ! of the new velocities and coordinates.
4476 velion(3, i) = gnh*velion(2, i) + gnih*(sov5(i, 7) + sov4(i, 2))
4477 else
4478 sov4(i, 2) = sov4(i, 1)*gn + tn*(velion(2, i) + eta_r)
4479 velion(2, i) = sov4(i, 1)*gni(1, 1) + gn*(velion(2, i) + eta_v)
4480 ! Propagate further by half dt without noise and forces
4481 velion(3, i) = gnh*velion(2, i)
4482 end if
4483
4484 end do
4485#ifdef DEBUG
4486 velion(1:2, 1:3) = 0.d0
4487 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' changed velocities 2 ',&
4488 &sum(velion(2, 1:ieskin)), sum(velion(1, 1:ieskin))
4489 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' changed velocities squares 2 ',&
4490 &sum(velion(2, 1:ieskin)**2), sum(velion(1, 1:ieskin)**2)
4491#endif
4492
4493 ! Now go back to the original basis
4494 if (yesturboq) then
4495 ! Tmes=dnrm2(ieskin,velion,3)**2/ieskin*ris(2)
4496 ! call reduce_base_real(1,Tmes,commcolrep_mpi,-1)
4497 ! if(rank.eq.0) write(6,*) ' sum after0',Tmes/nbead
4498
4499 ! Transformation back in the original basis
4500#ifdef PARALLEL
4501 do i = 0, nbead - 1
4502 sov5(1:ieskin, 1) = kdyn(i + 1, rankcolrep + 1)&
4503 &*sov4(1:ieskin, 2) ! coordinates
4504 sov5(1:ieskin, 2) = kdyn(i + 1, rankcolrep + 1)&
4505 &*velion(2, 1:ieskin) ! velocities
4506 sov5(1:ieskin, 3) = kdyn(i + 1, rankcolrep + 1)&
4507 &*velion(3, 1:ieskin) ! extra prop coordinates
4508 call reduce_base_real_to(3*ieskin, sov5, sov5(1, 4)&
4509 &, commcolrep_mpi, i)
4510 end do
4511 sov4(1:ieskin, 2) = sov5(1:ieskin, 4)
4512 velion(2, 1:ieskin) = sov5(1:ieskin, 5)
4513 velion(3, 1:ieskin) = sov5(1:ieskin, 6)
4514
4515! Tmes=dnrm2(ieskin,velion,3)**2/ieskin*ris(2)
4516! call reduce_base_real(1,Tmes,commcolrep_mpi,-1)
4517! if(rank.eq.0) write(6,*) ' sum after1',Tmes/nbead
4518#endif
4519 end if
4520
4521 call dgemv('N', ieskin, ieskin, 1.d0, cov, ieskin &
4522 &, velion(3, 1), 3, 0.d0, sov4, 1)
4523 call dgemv('N', ieskin, ieskin, 1.d0, cov, ieskin &
4524 &, velion(2, 1), 3, 0.d0, velion(3, 1), 3)
4525 call dgemv('N', ieskin, ieskin, 1.d0, cov, ieskin &
4526 &, sov4(1, 2), 1, 0.d0, psip(n2 + indi), 1)
4527
4528 ! back to the scale of coordinates
4529 ! write(6,*) ' Final correction inside '
4530 cost = 0.d0
4531 do i = 1, ieskin
4532 psip(n2 + indi + i - 1)&
4533 & = (psip(n2 + indi + i - 1)&
4534 & + sov4(i, 1))*psip(n3 + i - 1) - velion(1, i)
4535 velion(1, i) = sov4(i, 1)*psip(n3 + i - 1)
4536 if (psip(n3 + i - 1) .ne. 0.d0) then
4537 cost = cost + 1.d0
4538 else
4539 velion(3, i) = 0.d0
4540 end if
4541 end do
4542 tmes = dnrm2(ieskin, velion(3, 1), 3)**2/cost*ris(2)
4543 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Temperature (H)= ', tmes
4544 cost = dnrm2(ieskin, psip(n2 + indi), 1)
4545 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Norm change ions =', cost
4546
4547 !!!! FINE NEW IDYN=6
4548
4549 elseif (idyn .ge. 2) then
4550 ! simple second order Langevin dynamic assumed correct up

4568 ! velion(2,indin)=velion(3,j)

4573 ! write(6,*) ' ERROR idyn>1 does not work inconsitent # forces '&
4574 ! &,indin,ieskin
4575 ! errnoise=13
4576 ! endif
4577
4578 if (yesrootc) then
4579 cost = (delta0/2.d0)**2
4580 else
4581 if (temp .ne. 0.d0) then
4582 cost = delta0*0.5d0/temp
4583 else
4584 cost = 0.d0
4585 end if
4586 end if
4587
4588 ! do i=1,ieskin
4589 ! call dcopy(ieskin,cov(ieskin*(i-1)+1),1,sov4(1,i),1)
4590 ! call dscal(ieskin,cost,sov4(1,i),1)
4591 ! enddo
4592 call dscal(ieskin2, cost, cov, 1)
4593

4595 ! 1,nbin,fk(1,kp_ion+1),nbin,0.d0,sov(1,1,4),npm)
4596
4597 ! Mass correction

4599 indin = 0
4600 do j = npps, np
4601 indin = indin + 1
4602
4603 psip(n3 + indin - 1) = dsqrt(scalpar(ipip(n3 + j - 1))/dt)
4604 ! write(6,*) ' Inverse Mass =',indin,ipip(n3+j-1)

4607
4608 do j = 1, ieskin
4609 do i = 1, ieskin
4610 cov(ieskin*(j - 1) + i)&
4611 & = cov(ieskin*(j - 1) + i)&
4612 &*psip(n3 + i - 1)*psip(n3 + j - 1)
4613 end do
4614 end do
4615
4616 ! MC

4619 do i = 1, ieskin

4621 sov4(indi + i, 2) = sov4(indi + i, 2)*psip(n3 + i - 1)

4628

4631 ! enddo

4641

4644 end do
4645
4646 ! update velion(3,1)
4647
4648 cost = 2.d0*friction*temp*dt
4649
4650 do i = 1, ieskin
4651 ! write(6,*) ' force inside ',psip(indi+i),psip(n3+i-1)
4652 zeta = dsqrt(-2.d0*dlog(1.d0 - drand1())*cost)&
4653 &*dcos(2.d0*pi*drand1())
4654 ! write(6,*) ' zeta corrected ',zeta

4657 ! 1 (psip(indi+i)*psip(n3+i-1)+sov(i,npp,4))+zeta
4658 velion(3, i) = velion(3, i) + dt* &

4660 end do
4661
4662 ! Now the variation of coordinates up to order dt**2
4663
4664 ! calculation temperature
4665 ! (unit mass assumed for all velocities)
4666 tmes = dnrm2(ieskin, velion(3, 1), 3)**2/ieskin*ris(2)
4667
4668 elseif (idyn .eq. 3) then
4669 ! first diagonalize sov(1,1,4)

4671 dth = dt/2.d0
4672 else
4673 dth = dt
4674 end if
4675
4676 ! do i=1,ieskin
4677 ! cov(ieskin*(i-1)+i)=cov(ieskin*(i-1)+i)+friction
4678 ! enddo
4679 lworkd = 3*ieskin
4680
4681 call dsyev_my('V', 'L', ieskin, cov, ieskin, psip, info, nprocrep&
4682 &, rankrep, commrep_mpi)
4683
4684 ! call dsyev('V','L',ieskin,cov,ieskin,psip,psip(n5),lworkd,info)
4685 !
4686 if (yesrootc) then
4687 do i = 1, ieskin
4688 psip(i) = dsqrt(max(psip(i), 0.d0)) + friction
4689 end do
4690 else
4691 do i = 1, ieskin
4692 psip(i) = psip(i) + friction
4693 end do
4694 end if
4695
4696 if (rank .eq. 0) then
4697 write (6, *) ' Eigenvalues gamma chosen '
4698 do i = 1, ieskin
4699 write (6, *) i, psip(i)
4700 end do
4701 end if
4702
4703 if (info .ne. 0) then
4704 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *)&
4705 & ' Error in lapack dsyev dynamic !!! '
4706 errnoise = 4
4707 end if
4708
4709 ! The scale invariant criterium
4710 ! is gamma/sqrt(T) , so I have divided by the
4711 ! sqrt(T/T_0) where T_0=1000K
4712
4713 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *)&
4714 & ' Ratio dyn ='&
4715 &, (psip(ieskin) - friction)/sqrt(temp*157.8873306d0)
4716
4717 ! write(6,*) ' Spectrum gamma=',info,(psip(i)*dt,i=1,ieskin)
4718
4719 do i = 1, ieskin
4720 if (psip(i) .gt. 0.d0) then
4721 psip(n5 + i - 1) = (1.d0 - dexp(-psip(i)*dth))/psip(i)
4722 else
4723 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Refused eigenvalue ', i
4724 psip(n5 + i - 1) = dth
4725 end if
4726 end do
4727 ! compute the noise correction
4728 alphaqmc = 0.d0
4729
4730 do i = 1, ieskin
4731 if (psip(i) .gt. 0.d0) then
4732 ! psip(n4+i-1)=(psip(i)*2.d0*temp)*psip(i)*
4733 ! 1 sinh(dt*psip(i))/(4.d0*sinh(psip(i)*dt*.5d0)**2)
4734 ! the following is protected for overflow

4736 if (delta0 .ne. 0.d0 .and. normcorr .gt. 0.d0) then
4737 if (yesrootc) then
4738 alphaqmc = normcorr&
4739 &*(2.d0*(psip(i) - friction)/delta0)**2
4740 else
4741 alphaqmc =&
4742 &normcorr*2.d0*temp*(psip(i) - friction)/delta0
4743 end if
4744 else
4745 alphaqmc = 0.d0
4746 end if
4747 psip(n4 + i - 1) = psip(i)*temp*psip(i)* &
4748 & (1.d0 + cost)/(1.d0 - cost) - alphaqmc
4749 ! subtracting the noise already present in the forces
4750 else
4751 psip(n4 + i - 1) = 0.d0
4752 end if
4753
4754 all_dyn = all_dyn + psip(n4 + i - 1)
4755 ratio_dyn = ratio_dyn + alphaqmc
4756
4757 if (psip(n4 + i - 1) .gt. 0.d0) then
4758 psip(n4 + i - 1) = dsqrt(psip(n4 + i - 1))
4759 else
4760 if (yesrootc) write (6, *)&
4761 & ' Warning noise correction not possible '&
4762 &, i, psip(i), psip(n4 + i - 1)

4765 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *)&

4768 errnoise = 5
4769 end if
4770 end if
4771 end do
4772
4773 ! now we are able to update the velocity

4775 call dgemv('T', ieskin, ieskin, 1.d0, cov, ieskin &
4776 &, velion(3, 1), 3, 0.d0, sov4, 1)
4777 call dgemv('T', ieskin, ieskin, 1.d0, cov, ieskin &

4779
4780 if (yessecond) then

4784 &*dcos(2.d0*pi*drand1())
4785 sov4(i, 1) = sov4(i, 1)*dexp(-psip(i)*dth)&

4787 & + psip(n4 + i - 1)*zeta)
4788 end do

4794 velion(2, i) = sov4(i, 1)*dexp(-psip(i)*dth) &
4795 & + psip(n5 + i - 1)*(velion(2, i)&
4796 & + psip(n4 + i - 1)*zeta)
4797 end do
4798 else
4799 do i = 1, ieskin
4800 zeta = dsqrt(-2.d0*dlog(1.d0 - drand1()))&
4801 &*dcos(2.d0*pi*drand1())
4802 velion(2, i) = sov4(i, 1)*dexp(-psip(i)*dth)&
4803 & + psip(n5 + i - 1)*(velion(2, i)&
4804 & + psip(n4 + i - 1)*zeta)
4805 end do
4806 end if
4807

4809

4811 &, velion(2, 1), 3, 0.d0, velion(3, 1), 3)
4812
4813 if (.not. yessecond) tmes = dnrm2(ieskin, velion(3, 1), 3)**2&
4814 &/ieskin*ris(2)
4815 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Temperature (H)= ', tmes
4816
4817 ! endif idyn=3
4818 end if
4819
4820 indin = 0
4821 do i = npps, npp
4822 ! II order half integer times for velocities
4823 indin = indin + 1
4824 if (yessecond .and. idyn .eq. 3) then
4825 ! Old half time step
4826 psip(indi + n2 + indin - 1) = velion(1, indin)
4827 ! New half time step
4828 velion(1, indin) = dth*psip(n3 + indin - 1)*velion(3, indin)
4829 ! Full time step
4830 psip(indi + n2 + indin - 1) = psip(indi + n2 + indin - 1)&
4831 &+ velion(1, indin)
4832 else
4833 psip(indi + n2 + indin - 1) = dt*psip(n3 + indin - 1)&
4834 &*velion(3, indin)
4835 end if
4836 ! write(6,*) 'TEST',indin,velion(3,indin)&
4837 ! ,psip(n3+indin-1),psip(indi+n2+indin-1)
4838 end do
4839
4840 cost = dnrm2(ieskin, psip(n2 + indi), 1)
4841 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Norm change ions =', cost
4842 end if ! endif idyn.ge.2
4843 if (rank .eq. 0 .and. all_dyn .gt. 0) write (6, *) &
4844 & ' Ratio QMC noise/ALL noise', ratio_dyn/all_dyn
4845 ! do not move the ions and do not update velocities
4846 else
4847
4848 if (maxdev_dyn .ne. 0&
4849 & .and. devmaxp .gt. maxdev_dyn &
4850 & .and. idyn .gt. 0) then
4851 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Warning devmax too large Ions not moved this step '&
4852 &, devmaxp, maxdev_dyn
4853 acc_dyn = .false.
4854 end if
4855 do i = 1, ieskin
4856 psip(indi + n2 + i - 1) = 0.d0
4857 end do
4858 end if ! endif idyn.ge.0
4859 ! END ION DYNAMICS

4861 if (allocated(sov5)) deallocate (sov5)

4864 !> @brief Purifies the covariance matrix by removing translations and rotations
4865 !>
4866 !> This subroutine cleans the covariance matrix by:
4867 !> - Removing translations and rotations of the center of mass when not using PBC
4868 !> - Handling cases for number of ions >= 3 and < 3 differently
4869 !> - Allocating workspace arrays for calculations
4870 !> - Computing center of mass coordinates
4871 !> - Setting up rotation vectors
4872 !>
4873 !> @note Only applies when not using periodic boundary conditions and ieskin equals 3*niont
4874 subroutine cleancov
4875 implicit none
4876 integer indx, indy, indr
4877 real*8 scalprod
4878 real(8), dimension(:), allocatable :: vecprod
4879 real*8, external :: dlamch
4880 ! if not in the box and all the forces are calculated:
4881 ! purification of matrix
4882 ! cov from translations and rotations of the center of mass
4883
4884 if (ieskin .ge. 3*niont) then
4885 mineig = 4
4886 else
4887 mineig = 1
4888 end if
4889
4890 if (.not. iespbc .and. ieskin .eq. 3*niont) then
4891 allocate (riondcm(3, niont), vecrottr(3*niont, 6), &
4892 &projrottr(ieskin, ieskin), workgs(ieskin + 12)&
4893 &, vecprod(ieskin))
4894 if (epstion .lt. 0.d0) allocate (covpurif(ieskin, ieskin))
4895
4896 ! write(6,*) ' force before ',psip(indi+1:indi+ieskin)
4897 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) 'Center of mass of the system: '
4898 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) rioncm
4899
4900 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) 'Ion coordinates from the Center of mass'//&
4901 &' of the system: '
4902 riondcm = 0.d0
4903 indr = 0
4904 do i = 1, nion
4905 if (atom_number(i) .gt. 0) then
4906 indr = indr + 1
4907 do j = 1, 3
4908 riondcm(j, indr) = rion(j, i) - rioncm(j)
4909 end do
4910 ! write(6,*) 'Ion ',i
4911 ! write(6,*) riondcm(:,i)
4912 end if
4913 end do
4914
4915 vecrottr = 0.d0
4916 do j = 1, niont
4917 ! 3 rotation vectors of the ions
4918 ! vecrottr(3*(j-1)+1,1)= 0.d0
4919 vecrottr(3*(j - 1) + 2, 1) = -riondcm(3, j)
4920 vecrottr(3*(j - 1) + 3, 1) = riondcm(2, j)
4921 vecrottr(3*(j - 1) + 1, 2) = riondcm(3, j)
4922 ! vecrottr(3*(j-1)+2,2)= 0.d0
4923 vecrottr(3*(j - 1) + 3, 2) = -riondcm(1, j)
4924 vecrottr(3*(j - 1) + 1, 3) = -riondcm(2, j)
4925 vecrottr(3*(j - 1) + 2, 3) = riondcm(1, j)
4926 ! vecrottr(3*(j-1)+3,3)= 0.d0
4927 ! 3 translation vectors of the ions
4928 vecrottr(3*(j - 1) + 1, 4) = 1.d0
4929 vecrottr(3*(j - 1) + 2, 5) = 1.d0
4930 vecrottr(3*(j - 1) + 3, 6) = 1.d0
4931 end do
4932
4933 ! do k=4,6
4934 ! vecprod=0.d0
4935 ! do i=1,ieskin
4936 ! do j=1,ieskin
4937 ! vecprod(i)=vecprod(i)+cov(i+ieskin*(j-1))*vecrottr(j,k)
4938 ! enddo
4939 ! enddo
4940 !! write(6,*) 'cov*vecrottr',k
4941 !! write(6,*) vecprod
4942 ! enddo
4943
4944 ! check GM orthonorm
4945 ! do j=1,6
4946 ! write(6,*) ' vecrottr ',j,' before GS orthonormalization'
4947 ! write(6,*) vecrottr(:,j)
4948 ! enddo
4949
4950 ! check scalar product between rotations and translations
4951 ! do i=1,3
4952 ! do j=4,6
4953 ! scalprod=0.d0
4954 ! do k=1,ieskin
4955 ! scalprod=scalprod+vecrottr(k,i)*vecrottr(k,j)
4956 ! enddo
4957 !! write(6,*) ' vecrot',i,' vectr',j-3,' = ',scalprod
4958 ! enddo
4959 ! enddo
4960 ! if(rank.eq.0) then
4961 ! write(6,*) ' Before ortho '
4962 ! do j=1,6
4963 ! write(6,*) ' vecrottr ',j&
4964 ! &,' after GS orthonormalization'
4965 ! write(6,*) vecrottr(:,j)
4966 ! enddo
4967 ! endif
4968 call grahamo(vecrottr, workgs(7), workgs, ieskin, 6, info)
4969 ! info=0
4970 ! do i=1,6
4971 ! if(workGS(i).lt.dlamch('E')) then
4972 ! info=info+1
4973 ! vecrottr(:,i)=0.d0
4974 ! endif
4975 ! enddo
4976
4977 if (info .ne. 0) then
4978
4979 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) ' Warning found 6-', info&
4980 &, ' independent rotations !! '
4981 if (info .eq. 1 .and. rank .eq. 0) write (6, *) &
4982 &' Warning collinear molecule !!! '
4983 if (info .gt. 1) then
4984 if (rank .eq. 0) write (6, *)&
4985 & ' ERROR dependent roto-translations !!! '
4986 errnoise = 11
4987 end if
4988 end if
4989 ! check GS orthonorm
4990 ! if(rank.eq.0) then
4991 ! do j=1,6
4992 ! write(6,*) ' vecrottr ',j&
4993 ! &,' after GS orthonormalization'
4994 ! write(6,*) vecrottr(:,j)
4995 ! enddo
4996 ! do j=1,6
4997 ! do k=j,6
4998 ! write(6,*) ' scal j k =',j,k,
4999 ! sum(vecrottr(:,j)*vecrottr(:,k))
5000 ! enddo
5001 ! enddo
5002 ! endif
5003
5004 ! projector orthogonal space of the rotations
5005 projrottr = 0.d0
5006 do i = 1, ieskin
5007 projrottr(i, i) = 1.d0
5008 ! do j=1,ieskin
5009 ! do k=1,6
5010 ! projrottr(i,j) = projrottr(i,j)&
5011 ! &-vecrottr(i,k)*vecrottr(j,k)
5012 ! enddo
5013 ! enddo
5014 end do
5015 ! Optimization
5016 call dgemm('N', 'T', ieskin&
5017 &, ieskin, 6, -1.d0&
5018 &, vecrottr, ieskin&
5019 &, vecrottr, ieskin&
5020 &, 1.d0, projrottr, ieskin)
5021 !
5022 ! Purification of forces
5023 vecprod(1:ieskin) = psip(indi + 1:indi + ieskin)
5024
5025 call dgemv('N', ieskin, ieskin&
5026 &, 1.d0, projrottr, ieskin&
5027 &, vecprod, 1, 0.d0&
5028 &, psip(indi + 1), 1)
5029
5030 ! be biased.
5031
5032 ! purification of the cov matrix
5033 if (epstion .lt. 0.d0) then
5034 call dgemm('N', 'N', ieskin&
5035 &, ieskin, ieskin, 1.d0&
5036 &, cov, ieskin, projrottr&
5037 &, ieskin, 0.d0, covpurif&
5038 &, ieskin)
5039 call dgemm('N', 'N', ieskin&
5040 &, ieskin, ieskin, 1.d0&
5041 &, projrottr, ieskin&
5042 &, covpurif, ieskin, 0.d0&
5043 &, cov, ieskin)
5044 end if
5045 ! write(6,*) 'Purified cov matrix'
5046 ! do i=1,ieskin
5047 ! do j=1,ieskin
5048 ! write(6,*) i,j,cov(i+ieskin*(j-1))
5049 ! enddo
5050 ! enddo
5051 !! check purificated cov orthogonal to vecrottr
5052 ! do i=1,3
5053 ! do j=4,6
5054 ! scalprod=0.d0
5055 ! do k=1,ieskin
5056 ! scalprod=scalprod+vecrottr(k,i)*vecrottr(k,j)
5057 ! enddo
5058 ! if(rank.eq.0) write(6,*) ' vecrot'
5059 ! ,i,' vectr',j-3,' = ',scalprod
5060 ! enddo
5061 ! enddo
5062
5063 mineig = 7 - info
5064 mineig = min(mineig, ieskin) ! Cannot be larger than ieskin
5065
5066 deallocate (riondcm, vecrottr, projrottr, workgs, vecprod)
5067 if (epstion .lt. 0.d0) deallocate (covpurif)
5068 end if
5069
5070 end subroutine cleancov

subroutine reweight0::update_index

Updates indices for complex parameters in quantum Monte Carlo calculations.

This subroutine handles the indexing of complex parameters, including:

  • Setting up arrays for tracking complex parameters
  • Handling real and imaginary parts of parameters
  • Managing symmetry-related parameters
  • Updating indices for modulus one parameters
Note
The subroutine uses global variables and arrays defined in the module scope
